7 Brew Crème Brûlée Latte: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium Crème Brûlée Latte is about $4.50, with 260 calories, 120 mg of caffeine and 36 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Crème Brûlée Latte allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Crème Brûlée Latte. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Crème Brûlée Latte

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Crème Brûlée Latte?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Crème Brûlée Latte at Home (Copycat Recipe)

The stand version fakes the dessert with three syrups instead of a torch: cane sugar for the custard sweetness, toasted marshmallow for the caramelized crust note, salted caramel for depth. Equal thirds is the ratio that keeps all three readable.

For one medium iced Crème Brûlée Latte (24 oz cup)

  • 1/3 oz cane sugar syrup (or simple syrup)
  • 1/3 oz toasted marshmallow syrup
  • 1/3 oz salted caramel syrup or sauce
  • About 8 oz milk
  • A full cup of ice
  • 2 shots of espresso (about 2 oz), hot
  1. Pour all three syrups and the milk into the cup and stir.
  2. Add the ice.
  3. Pour the hot espresso over the top and stir once.

Closest to the dessert: order or make it hot at regular sweet with a caramel drizzle. Lighter: half sweet cuts the sugar hard on this one, and the three flavors actually separate better. No espresso machine? Use 2 oz of very strong coffee. Note there is no official sugar-free version at the stand, so a home sugar-free build is your own experiment, not a menu copy.

7 Brew Crème Brûlée Latte FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Crème Brûlée Latte?

A medium iced Crème Brûlée Latte has 260 calories. A small has 180 and a large 300, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Crème Brûlée Latte?

About 120 mg in a medium. Small is 120 mg and large is 240 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Crème Brûlée Latte cost?

Roughly $3.95 for a small, $4.50 for a medium and $5.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Crème Brûlée Latte?

36 g in a medium.

What is in a 7 Brew Crème Brûlée Latte?

Espresso, milk and three flavors in equal roles, per the official menu: cane sugar, toasted marshmallow and salted caramel. The cane sugar gives the custard sweetness, the toasted marshmallow gives the caramelized, almost burnt-sugar note of a real brûlée crust, and the salted caramel adds depth. There is no vanilla syrup in the build, even though the drink tastes like vanilla custard.

Does the Crème Brûlée Latte have a torched sugar top?

No. There is no torch and no crackly crust at the stand. The three syrups imitate that caramelized top instead. A caramel drizzle on a hot one is the closest the drink gets to the dessert's crust.

Is there a sugar-free Crème Brûlée Latte?

No official one. 7 Brew's nutrition guide lists no sugar-free version of this drink, and it publishes no nutrition for a sugar-free build. Some fan pages claim you can build one from sugar-free syrups, but that is not a menu drink with official numbers. Order it half sweet or quarter sweet instead. A medium iced at regular sweet has 260 calories and 36 g of sugar. Every drink that does offer a sugar-free version is compared on our sugar-free page.

Is the Crème Brûlée Latte a copy of the Starbucks caramel brûlée latte?

It scratches the same itch, and fans do order it as the 7 Brew answer to the Starbucks seasonal drink. The builds differ though: 7 Brew uses cane sugar, toasted marshmallow and salted caramel, and it is on the menu year-round as a Classic, not a holiday special.

How do I make a crème brûlée latte at home?

Stir about 1/3 oz each of cane sugar syrup, toasted marshmallow syrup and salted caramel into about 8 oz of milk over ice, then pour 2 shots of espresso in. The full copycat recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
